text.Frontier Station:
Frontier Station Frontier Station.jpg Colony Wars Machine Cult Outpost 6 defense 6 1 2 or 3 
 How to Play ==
When you play Frontier Station you put in play an Outpost with a defense of 6 and you gain 2 Trade or 3 Combat.
 Strategy ==
Frontier Station has a good defense with 6. Some flexibility you get from adding 2 Trade to your purchase power or adding 3 Combat for your attack.
